name: Caja POS — admin busca producto, cobra y ve el ticket en Ventas
description: Un admin abre Caja desde el menú o desde Registrar venta, agrega un producto al carrito, confirma la compra y luego ve la línea del ticket en Ventas/Tickets.

planSteps.description: Sign in with the admin email and password configured for this project
Open Caja from the sidebar navigation
Verify the Caja page shows product search, cart area, payment methods and Confirmar compra
Search or scan a product and add it to the cart
Verify the cart shows at least one line item and a non-zero total a pagar
Select Efectivo as payment method and click Confirmar compra
Verify a success message with ticket number appears and the cart is cleared
Verify the sales table includes the newly created ticket line
